title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: One good thing each
hook: Could you name one thing each player did well today?
intro: A few players got all the praise.
statement: Every kid wants to know their coach noticed them.
q1: Do you tell each player one thing they did well —
q2: or praise the team as a whole?
q3: Which players went home without hearing it?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids come back
t2: when they know you saw their effort.
cta: Coaches — how do you spread praise?
ctaLines: One thing each. A shout-out circle. A note home.
Each player or the whole team?
ctaPrompt: Share your praise habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Could you name one thing each player did well today?
Practice ends. A few players got all the praise.
Every kid wants to know their coach noticed them.
Praise each player or praise the team. Both can work.
How do you spread praise? Share your habit in the comments.
